title: What They Remember of Me
about: A digital album built from early memories told through the voices of my family, capturing moments from 2000 to 2010 that helped shape the foundation of who I am.
description: What They Remember of Me is a memory-driven collection created from stories shared by my grandmothers, my mom, and my Aunt Bobbie. Each track reflects a moment, perspective, or piece of my early life as seen through the people who were there. Instead of a single narrative, the album is built from different viewpoints, blending together to form a picture of my beginnings. It captures small moments, meaningful memories, and the impressions I left before I was old enough to fully understand them myself.
